name: exception-exact-data-and-cause
expression: (let [v (eval '(defmacro review-exact-cause [] (throw (ex-info "outer" {:decimal 1.00M} (ex-info "inner" {:ratio 2/3}))))) ] (try (v nil nil) (catch Throwable e [(ex-message e) (ex-data e) (ex-message (ex-cause e)) (ex-data (ex-cause e))])))

name: ordinary-error-message-without-info-data
expression: (let [v (eval '(defmacro review-divide-error [] (/ 1 0)))] (try (v nil nil) (catch Throwable e [(ex-message e) (ex-data e)])))

name: nil-info-message
expression: (let [v (eval '(defmacro review-nil-message [] (throw (ex-info nil {}))))] (try (v nil nil) (catch Throwable e [(ex-message e) (ex-data e)])))
